question: Under the ‘Mukhyamantri Awasiya Bhu Adhikar Yojana’ launched by the Chief Minister of Madhya Pradesh, plots worth about ________ crore were distributed to 10,918 families of Tikamgarh district.
solution:
The correct answer is **__₹129__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Mukhyamantri Awasiya Bhu Adhikar Yojana’s** plots worth about ₹ 129 crore were distributed to 10,918 families of Tikamgarh district.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The Madhya Pradesh govt has announced the Mukhyamantri Awasiya Bhu-adhikar Yojna.
 
• Under the scheme, the state government will provide plots to families that don't have land to build their own homes.
 
• Residential plots to the eligible families will be provided on Abadi land in each Gram Panchayat.
 
• ​A family must consist of a couple and their unmarried children to be eligible for the scheme.
 
• Chief Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan launched the Chief Minister's Residential Land Rights scheme

68:T
